payload.title: [Fig. 9] Schematic for the Plume Distance
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook aims to enhance the understanding of the plume distance metric by providing a schematic illustration that integrates multiple steps of the process. It involves loading and processing climate ensemble data from LMRonline and LMRv2.1 datasets, resampling data according to a power law, and calculating the plume distance. The notebook uses various visualization techniques to plot proximity probabilities and densities, ultimately combining these into a comprehensive schematic. The outputs include visual plots that depict intra- and inter-ensemble distances and the calculated plume distance.
goals: Illustrate the plume distance metric with a schematic.
Integrate multiple steps of the process into a single visualization.
Enhance understanding of intra- vs inter-ensemble distances.
